meaning:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.38.2;
father of: Bath-shua (H1323I)
Also named: shu.a (שׁוּעָא "Shua" H7774H)
§ Shuah = "wealth"
father of Judah's wife

elsewhere.note: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight…
